name: unblock-consumer
description: Watches every app.bsky.graph.block record on the network over Jetstream, keeps who each one blocked in a SQLite file on the droplet, and when one is deleted sends the unblock on to Supabase for /experimenting/unblocking. Runs on the DigitalOcean droplet alongside the anisota, tracker, turtle and mod consumers.

comments.dependencies: There are none, as with the mod-consumer. WebSocket and SQLite are both built into Node 22 (node:sqlite from 22.5; the --experimental-sqlite flag is needed before 22.13 and accepted after), and systemd's EnvironmentFile reads .env. The one module it shares with the site, api/_lib/unblockDb.js, has no dependencies either, so unlike the mod-consumer this needs no npm install at all: a checkout is enough.
